name: Temporary recover full-roadmap tracking synchronizer

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - tracking/full-roadmap-projection
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/tmp-recover-full-roadmap-tracking.yml

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  recover:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: tracking/full-roadmap-projection
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
      - name: Let projection workflow settle and reconcile branch
        run: |
          sleep 15
          git fetch origin tracking/full-roadmap-projection
          git reset --hard origin/tracking/full-roadmap-projection
      - name: Recover validated synchronizer from immutable machine projection
        shell: bash
        run: |
          git show 3137890:machine/documents/.github/workflows/tmp-apply-full-roadmap-tracking.yml.json > /tmp/recovery.json
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import base64, gzip, json, re
          from pathlib import Path
          payload = json.loads(Path('/tmp/recovery.json').read_text())
          text = payload['content']
          match = re.search(r"printf '%s' '([A-Za-z0-9+/=]+)' \| base64 -d \| gzip -dc > scripts/sync-github-tracking.py", text)
          if not match:
              raise SystemExit('validated synchronizer payload not found')
          data = gzip.decompress(base64.b64decode(match.group(1)))
          Path('scripts/sync-github-tracking.py').write_bytes(data)
          PY
          python3 -m py_compile scripts/sync-github-tracking.py
          python3 scripts/sync-github-tracking.py --validate
      - name: Commit synchronizer source
        run: |
          git config user.name "Thomas Carter"
          git config user.email "monadframework@gmail.com"
          git add scripts/sync-github-tracking.py
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "Synchronizer already matches validated source."
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "feat(github): synchronize full roadmap tracking source"
          git pull --rebase origin tracking/full-roadmap-projection
          git push origin HEAD:tracking/full-roadmap-projection
